defect_observations: held-sources.json registers source/references/acq-r1-ACQ-2026-10-0497/schwichtenberg-1977-proof-theory-applications-cut-elimination.pdf (sha256 0226941f..., 1186 PDF pages) only under Schwichtenberg1977, but its version field says it is a whole-book scan of the 1993 eighth impression of the 1977 first edition of the Handbook of Mathematical Logic with 1977 pagination. Probe pages show the imprint (PDF p.8), Barwise ch. A.1 running head at printed p.8 (PDF p.24), and Keisler ch. A.2 at printed p.48 (PDF p.64). The SRC-001-001 extent pp. 5-46 therefore appears to be physically present in a held file. Whether an eighth-impression facsimile satisfies the SRC-001 version identity (which distinguishes impressions and assumes no physical-file identity) and should be registered for SRC-001 / ACQ-2026-10-0427 is a lead decision; this assessment does not treat SRC-001 as held.
